requests.request_text_proposed: Add strict JSON-lines iteration: require one complete value per nonblank line, return the failing line number, preserve earlier callbacks, and stop before later lines.
internal_definitions: 0: original ForEachLine signature; spy exported Result primitives
1: per-line Valid then Parse; own Outcome+ErrInvalidLine
2: validate all nonblank lines first, then Parse/yield; own Outcome+ErrInvalidLine

captions.caption: Consumes successive JSON values, yields each parsed result, and honors callback stop without enforcing physical line validation.
Checks every nonblank physical line before yielding any result, then delivers results and honors callback stop.
Checks each nonblank physical line before yielding, returns the first invalid line, and preserves earlier callbacks and stop.

requests.request_text_proposed: Add strict UTF8 JSON-string append: reject malformed input before changing destination, retain existing escaping for valid input, and return an explicit encoding error.
internal_definitions: 0: original AppendJSONString signature; no error channel
1: utf8.ValidString before all writes; invalid returns unchanged dst and own ErrInvalidUTF8; valid delegates AppendJSONString
2: append opening quote before utf8.ValidString; invalid returns partial dst and own ErrInvalidUTF8; valid remove provisional quote then delegate AppendJSONString

captions.caption: Checks UTF-8 before writing, rejects malformed input with an encoding error, and appends using existing escaping for valid input.
Appends an opening quote before checking UTF-8, returns an encoding error for malformed input, and uses existing escaping otherwise.
Appends a quoted JSON string using existing escaping, replacing malformed UTF-8 bytes with U+FFFD while retaining the destination prefix.
